summary: Rendered ArgoCDDeploy and ProofDeploy live and checked the standup's chart-authored deliverables (register values, both ApplicationSets, AppProject, notifications, SSO, webhook secret indirection, hook namespace, repo-creds, CA-trust mount) directly against the output; verification.json marks V01-V06,V08,V09,V28-V30 verified on that evidence. Operator's bootstrap runbook: close-out.md A1 (helm install sequence, namespace-adoption edge), A2 (three OpenBao leaves plus the hand-created Keycloak client, now recording it on Trello #68), A3 (DNS/NAT/webhook for deploy-hooks.webathome.org), A4 (the throwaway-app register/deploy/undeploy/unregister drill, ProofDeploy already pushed and gated green).
